gate.rule: A capability enters this registry only if promote() returns ok=True.
gate.research_to_production: A P2 research record is NOT a production capability. Promotion requires independent evidence and, for third-party material, a security assessment that P2 explicitly did not perform.

deferred.reason: LCP and INP numeric thresholds were never retrieved (CONF-001). A verifier cannot encode an unverified number.
CMS content-modelling depth remains RESEARCH_FURTHER; the Contentful reference returned HTTP 429 in P2.
Only CLS thresholds are verified. hreflang, international, local and entity SEO were not researched.
Per-harness behavioural parity was never established; bulk adoption would import unverified assumptions.
Self-reported confidence is not independent evidence. Requires a user-approved proposal mechanism first.
Tkinter GUI is incompatible with an agent-neutral, CLI-first architecture.
The registry documents that it delegates security scanning and does not scan server code.
A persona corpus is not a runtime. Useful as requirement vocabulary only, not an installable capability.
Gemini CLI documentation was not retrieved (HTTP 404 on both URLs). No adapter may be built on an unread specification.
